title: Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.09135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. To make TTRL applicable to code generation, we propose probe-driven TTRL, which constructs output-free probe inputs from the problem statement, executes candidate programs on these probes, and defines a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) from the resulting behavioral agreement. PCR provides a behavioral training signal for open-vocabulary programs, but it is not a fully reliable verifier and remains susceptible to reward hacking through spurious consensus. translated_title: 熵正则化秩掩码策略优化用于代码生成中的测试时强化学习
translated_abstract: 现有的测试时强化学习（TTRL）方法通过对具有标准答案的无标注测试时任务进行答案级别的自投票来获取奖励，但这种方法在代码生成任务中会失效，因为程序无法通过表面形式进行比较，因而无法直接提供可用的训练信号。为了使TTRL适用于代码生成，我们提出了探针驱动的TTRL（probe-driven TTRL），该方法从问题描述中构建无需标准输出的探针输入，在这些探针上执行候选程序，并根据所得的行为一致性定义探针一致性奖励。PCR为开放词汇的程序提供了行为层面的训练信号，但它并非完全可靠的验证器，仍然容易因虚假共识而遭受奖励攻击。因此，我们引入了熵正则化秩掩码策略优化，它通过秩掩码机制将低PCR转化为保守的负向更新，并控制策略熵（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出探针驱动的测试时强化学习方法，通过探针一致性奖励（PCR）为开放词汇的程序提供行为训练信号，并利用熵正则化秩掩码策略优化（ERPO）抵御奖励攻击，使TTRL成功应用于代码生成任务。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes probe-driven TTRL with a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) to provide behavioral training signals for open-vocabulary programs, combined with Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization (ERPO) to resist reward hacking, thereby enabling test-time reinforcement learning for code generation.
